name: Akuchi Tarou
source:
Bodyguard at Mado Psychics. Along with Suzu, he lives and works at the office. He's quiet and seemingly unfeeling, as well as physically and mentally strong. He instinctively protects the small and weak. For some reason, Ayataka hates him.

Age: Early 30s

[From Love 365's in-app character introduction.]
